sn47.2:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Vesali in Ambapali’s Grove.
sn47.2:1.2: There the Blessed One addressed the bhikkhus thus:
sn47.2:2.1: “Bhikkhus, a bhikkhu should dwell mindful and clearly comprehending:
sn47.2:2.2: this is our instruction to you.
sn47.2:2.3: “And how, bhikkhus, is a bhikkhu mindful?
sn47.2:2.4: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.2:2.5: He dwells contemplating feelings in feelings …
sn47.2:2.7: phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.2:2.8: It is in this way, bhikkhus, that a bhikkhu is mindful.
sn47.2:3.1: “And how, bhikkhus, does a bhikkhu exercise clear comprehension?
sn47.2:3.2: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu is one who acts with clear comprehension when going forward and returning; when looking ahead and looking aside; when drawing in and extending the limbs; when wearing his robes and carrying his outer robe and bowl; when eating, drinking, chewing his food, and tasting; when defecating and urinating; when walking, standing, sitting, falling asleep, waking up, speaking, and keeping silent. It is in such a way that a bhikkhu exercises clear comprehension.
sn47.2:3.4: a bhikkhu should dwell mindful and clearly comprehending.
sn47.2:3.5: This is our instruction to you.”
